reviews.text: I wanted to visit a mosques to know more about my neighbors and their religion. It was extremely disappointing. No one there greeted me nor showed me where to go as a visitor. I did not feel welcomed there AT ALL and decided to leave. Is this a normal thing in Islam and other mosques? I've visited all types of churches, temples, gurdwaras, synagogues, Zoroastrian fire temples, and have NEVER been treated as poorly as I have in that mosques. I will try another one somewhere else and hopefully will not have to judge Islam and Muslims off of this one community. God Bless.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

One of the best Islamic centers I have visited. The mosque is beautiful, exceptionally clean, and has a peaceful, welcoming atmosphere. The community is friendly, warm, and makes everyone feel at home.

A special thank you to Imam Dr. Alaa Al-Sharif for his knowledge, kindness, and dedication. May Allah reward him abundantly and place all his efforts in the scale of his good deeds.

May Allah also reward everyone who has contributed to building, maintaining, and supporting this mosque. May He accept their deeds and continue to bless this wonderful community.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a welcoming place to pray and connect with the Muslim community.

A Wonderful Community (Spartanburg Mosque )is truly a special place, The community is welcoming, kind, and feels like a big family, There are activities, gatherings, and opportunities to come together throughout the week, as well as during every holiday and special occasion.
The people are friendly, supportive, and always willing to make you feel welcome, The leaders also deserve so much appreciation for their dedication, kindness, and the effort they put into bringing everyone together and making the mosque a place where everyone feels at home,
I’m grateful to be part of such a wonderful community\. May Allah bless the mosque, its leaders, and everyone who continues to make this community so beautiful\.
